# freshdesk_skill (Data Source)

Look up a single routing skill by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_skill" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the skill to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the agents who hold the skill.
- `conditions` (String) Matching rules, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the skill was created (RFC 3339).
- `match_type` (String) Whether all or any conditions must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill.
- `rank` (Number) Evaluation order of the skill.
- `updated_at` (String) When the skill was last changed (RFC 3339).
